decisions.evidence: Across all six neighbors, the positive-neighbor set and the negative-neighbor set both end up favoring the same conclusion: the query consistently shows stronger drug-likeness, higher neutral fraction, and several favorable structural differences, while the main recurring unfavorable feature is the absence of a basic site relative to neighbors that do carry a strongest basic pKa. Because the favorable signals are more numerous and more coherent across the six comparisons, the combined local evidence supports option (B), meaning oral bioavailability ≥20%.
